name: BackToTop
title: BackToTop
summary: A 48px round button fixed at the bottom-right of long pages that scrolls back to the top and returns focus to the start of the content.
whenToUse: Use it on long pages: articles, stories, the Statement of Faith, policy pages, the resource library.
Show it only after the reader has scrolled about two screen heights.
whenNotToUse: Do not use it on short pages or inside app screens and modals.

anatomy.description: One icon-only button: an up arrow in a white circle with a hairline and `var(--shadow-overlay)`. `.nv-btt-fixed` pins it 24px from the bottom-right corner (16px below 768px).

props.name: threshold
props.description:
Scroll distance in px after which the button appears. Defaults to two screen heights.
Set `0` to always show it.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name (the button has no visible text).

props.name: dark
props.description: Charcoal variant for use over black sections (footer, dark heroes).

props.name: fixed
props.description: Pin to the bottom-right corner (`.nv-btt-fixed`). One per page.

props.name: focusTarget
props.description: CSS selector of the element that receives focus after scrolling: the skip link target.

variantNotes: **Focus:** 2px `var(--horizon-blue)` outline, 2px offset, `var(--shadow-focus)` plus the overlay shadow.

**On dark (`.nv-btt-dark`):** `var(--charcoal-900)` fill, `rgba(255,255,255,.22)` border, white arrow; hover `var(--charcoal-800)`. Switch to it while the button sits over black sections (footer, dark heroes).
**Hidden:** `hidden` until the reader passes two screens; fade in over 150ms.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Keep it 48x48 (above the 44px minimum), round, bottom-right.
Use the up arrow only. Never use ⌄, ↗ or ›, and never add a text label beside it.
Never colour it Horizon Blue; it is a utility, not a primary action.
Stack it above the cookie banner (`z-index:72` vs `.cookie` 70) and keep clear of it: the banner is bottom-left, this is bottom-right.
Keep it clear of sticky app banners and chat widgets; move it up by their height if they share the corner.
do: Use it on long pages: articles, stories, the Statement of Faith, policy pages, the resource library.

accessibility: It is a `<button>` with `aria-label="Back to top"`; the SVG is `aria-hidden`.
On click, scroll to the top and move focus to `main[tabindex="-1"]` (the skip link target), so keyboard users restart at the content.
When hidden use the `hidden` attribute, so it is not in the tab order.
content: Accessible name: "Back to top". No visible text.

html:
<button class="nv-btt nv-btt-fixed" type="button" aria-label="Back to top" hidden>
  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 19V5M5 12l7-7 7 7"/></svg>
</button>
